questions.a: Ahaziah fell down through the lattice in his upper chamber in Samaria, and was injured.

questions.q: Why was Ahaziah going to certainly die?
questions.a: Because Ahaziah consulted with Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, he would certainly die.
Elijah wore a garment made of hair, and he had a leather belt wrapped around his waist.

questions.q: What consumed the captain and his fifty men?
questions.a: A fire came down from heaven, called by Elijah, and it consumed the captain and his fifty men.

questions.q: How did the third captain approach Elijah?
questions.a: The third captain went up, fell on his knees before Elijah, and begged him to value his life and the lives of his men.

questions.q: Why did Joram begin to reign in the place of Ahaziah?
questions.a: Joram began to reign in his place because Ahaziah had no son.
